known_limitations: All four fixes are API-boundary enforcement in a single-process Python simulator, not physics. Code that imports qmint.protocols.register/_CAPABILITIES or kent_smoney_2022._BOB_SIDE, walks gc, or calls the private accessors (_register, _qubits, _bob, _bank) still reaches amplitudes/secrets; such code is OUT_OF_MODEL.

Private accessors _register/_qubits (RegisterHandle) and _bob (KentSMoneySession) are kept as properties because lane M's passing documentation tests use them and this lane may only remove xfail markers there.

M-B4: S1 applicability is IN_MODEL only when a SpacetimeNetwork is passed and the two presentation events are certainly spacelike (is_spacelike, clock bounds included); without a network a double presentation is labelled OUT_OF_MODEL. Bob's per-site outcomes/events are still readable by in-process Alice code; with spacelike presentations that cannot inform the other presentation in the modelled physics. Routing S1 through lane G's engine (auditor's remedy) is not done here.

RegisterHandle(register, qubits, record) constructor is still a simulator-internal entry point: code holding a FactorizedRegister can wrap the same live qubits twice (aliasing, not cloning). Reaching a register requires out-of-model introspection.
